query: Payroll normally exports CSV with one click, but occasionally needs an Excel download instead.
In the newsletter editor, keep bold, italic and alignment commands together above the copy.
Our suppliers directory has 8,000 companies. Let buyers type a few letters and pick the right supplier.
Finance needs to specify both the earliest and latest dates for expense reimbursement.
If an applicant says they own a business, ask for the registration number. Everyone else should skip that question.
An analyst has edited a forecast but hasn't saved it. Check whether she wants to keep working before closing it.
Our auditors need to jump straight back to page 18 of last quarter's transactions.
Recruiters want to narrow vacancies by department, seniority and location at the same time.
A claims examiner should be able to read each case while the inbox stays visible beside it.
Translators need to drag the boundary between the source document and translation to make either side wider.
When someone hovers over the unfamiliar stamp icon or tabs to it, tell them what the stamp does.
Before permanently removing a supplier, ask the buyer to confirm or cancel.
A new store has zero products. Explain how its owner can add the first one.
Payment processing will be unavailable on Sunday. Make that announcement visible on every page.
Sort purchase orders by due date so the earliest payments appear first.
Let support leads close forty resolved tickets with one action after selecting them.
Photographers need to cancel one transfer while the remaining photos continue uploading.
Reviewers need to pause a recorded interview and jump back to a particular moment.
In our print shop, let staff drag each job from Proofing to Approved to Printed as it advances.
Dispatchers should be able to move a delivery stop to the top of the route and preserve the new order.
Is there a correlation between an account's headcount and its annual spend? Show a point for each account.
Which stage loses the most candidates between application, screening, interview and hire?
Which installation jobs overlap on the calendar and how many days is each scheduled to run?
Shade each county by the percentage of households with broadband access.
